About Lido DAO

Lido is the largest liquid-staking protocol, issuing stETH to people who stake ETH through it. LDO is the governance token of the Lido DAO.

Where this LDO price comes from

The price above updates live in your browser from Coinbase (LDO-USD), Binance (LDO/USDT) and Kraken (LDO/USD), and the badge shows which exchange reported the latest trade. Market cap is the live price × a circulating supply of about 895,802,000 LDO (supply last updated October 30, 2026).
